chapter: Family and childhood in Baton Rouge
title: Musicians in the family; no kin to the Darenburgs
summary: Joe says nobody in his family was a professional musician apart from an uncle on the circus and an amateur father, and he is not related to Percy or Caffrey Darenburg.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: All right. Now, the first thing I wanted to ask you, I wanted to dispel all the things that have been going around. People say you were related to Caffrey(?) Darenburg and related to Percy Darenburg. Who actually in your family were musicians? Anybody or no?

Nobody in my family were professional musicians. But an uncle of mine named Willie Darenbourg was a trombone player that played on the Ringling Brothers Circus and the Hagenbech(?)—Wallace Circus outside. And my father was an amateur musician.
So Percy Darenburg and Caffrey(?) Darenburg are no kin whatsoever.
In the first place, they spell their name different from mine. I think they spell their name Darenburg, and mine is spelled Darenbourg.
